name: Matsuzaki (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Matsuzaki town emblem in green: a disc with an interlaced loop at the top, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Matsuzaki, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 November 1965.

features.role: Matsuzaki town emblem — a disc with an interlaced loop at the top, like a stylised character
